description: This Java interface extends Spring Data JPA repositories to manage ExternalAssetOwnerTransferLoanMapping entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and custom queries related to loan and transfer IDs.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnerTransferLoanMappingRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for ExternalAssetOwnerTransferLoanMapping entity, combining CRUD and specification executor functionalities, with custom query methods for fetching mappings by external IDs.

methods.name: deleteByLoanIdAndOwnerTransfer
methods.description: Deletes a mapping based on loan ID and owner transfer.

methods.name: findByLoanId
methods.description: Finds a mapping by loan ID.

methods.name: findByLoanExternalId
methods.description: Finds a mapping by the external loan ID associated with the owner transfer.

methods.name: findByTransferExternalId
methods.description: Finds a mapping by the external ID of the transfer.
